preconditions.description: The depth of the initial tree n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 4 for x in [int(query.split()[1]) for query in queries if query.startswith('1')])
preconditions.description: Each x in the '1 x' queries is between 1 and 4 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, int) for output in outputs)
all(0 <= output < 1000000007 for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.

postconditions.expression: len(outputs) == sum(1 for query in queries if query == '2')
postconditions.description: The number of outputs matches the number of '2' queries.
